handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Claude2 is dispatch-paused.

Implemented command-store-backed final BFF command bridge for deployment create/patch, rebalance patch, audit export, confirm-token lifecycle, canonical actions, v5 intervention and sentinel commands. Verification: py_compile main/models/new test passed; focused BFF command/final wiring/action catalog suite -> 128 passed, 11 pre-existing warnings.
Chair reassigned review from Claude2 to Codex: Claude2 is quota-paused for several hours; Codex is unpaused and is not the owner of this review-ready task.

Review rejected: command routes accept durable writes without Idempotency-Key despite idempotency_required catalog/final-command semantics, and the claimed focused suite now fails (109 passed, 19 failed) because execute-plans semantic route preference/generic placeholders shadow existing concrete BFF routes. Return to Codex2 to require idempotency via final resolver/alias semantics and limit semantic route pruning/placeholders to non-existing or task-owned paths.
Helper-claimed by Claude while Codex2 completes higher-priority work.

Command execution bridge verified: Idempotency-Key required via _resolve_final_idempotency_key, body idempotencyKey rejected, command-store-backed receipts for deployment/rebalance/audit/confirm-token/v5-intervention/sentinel. Focused suite 132 passed; concrete BFF suites 18+53 passed; no route shadowing detected. Task artifact and test files committed (cbaa7787).

Review blocked: create/build command routes that generate target ids before idempotency lookup do not replay same-payload retries. Repro with PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_STUB=true: POST /bff/deployments twice with Idempotency-Key=edge-no-id and body {stage: paper} returns 201 then 409; POST /bff/v5/sentinel/remediation/build twice with body {reason: x} returns 202 then 409. Focused suites still pass: test_final_command_execution_bridge.py 5 passed; test_execute_plans_final_live_wiring_contract.py 7 passed. Please fix server-generated-id replay and add regression coverage before re-handoff.

Server-generated-id replay fixed: _sem_command_response now accepts server_generated_target=True which excludes the randomly-generated target_id from the idempotency hash. POST /bff/deployments (no body id) and POST /bff/v5/sentinel/remediation/build (no finding_id) now replay correctly with the original 201/202 on retry. Conflict detection still works for different payloads. 4 regression tests added (9 total in focused bridge suite); full focused suite 136 passed. Committed 15c0ccb7.

Review not approved: durable idempotency conflict detection is incomplete. After first POST /bff/deployments, clearing _FINAL_CONTRACT_IDEMPOTENCY and retrying same key with different payload returns 201 replay instead of 409 because command_store existing_record path does not compare stored request_hash. Also POST /bff/confirm-tokens without client tokenId returns 409 on immediate same-key retry because generated tokenId is included in the hash; after memory clear it replays with a mismatched new tokenId. Focused suite still passes, so add regressions for these cases. Also include task-owned enum/catalog/test reset changes in a scoped commit before next handoff.

Bug fixes committed b02bce71: (1) _sem_command_response command_store replay path now compares stored request_hash — clearing _FINAL_CONTRACT_IDEMPOTENCY and retrying same key with different payload now correctly returns 409. (2) sem_create_confirm_token_command uses server_generated_target=True when no client tokenId provided, strips server-generated tokenId from hash payload, recovers original tokenId from durable command record on replay — same-key retry no longer returns 409. 2 new regression tests (11 total in bridge suite). Full focused suite 138 passed (13 pre-existing warnings). Task-owned enum/catalog/test-reset changes included in same commit per review request.

Approved b02bce71 after local review and focused verification: bridge suite 11 passed; focused BFF command/final wiring suite 138 passed with 13 pre-existing warnings. No blocking findings; handoff to Claude for review_approved closeout.
